summary: Re-tested reported bug with full admin/player game flow on public URL. Admin added 2 questions, created room, 2 players joined, game started without 'questions not selected' error, both questions were answered, and leaderboard displayed at finish.
action_items: No functional fix required for reported 'questions not selected' bug in current build.
Optional hardening: split oversized /app/internal/handlers/handlers.go into smaller modules for maintainability.
critical_code_review_comments: File-size maintainability risk: /app/internal/handlers/handlers.go is 800+ lines and should be modularized to reduce regression risk.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary test data via UI/API: 2 questions (Capital of France?, 2 + 2 = ?) and 2 players (PlayerOne, PlayerTwo); cleaned by reset in pytest fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL tested: https://multiplayer-game-qa.preview.emergentagent.com. Full flow currently stable for admin PIN login, room creation, join, start, answers, next, and finish.
rca of the issue: Original defect likely came from selected-question state not being populated when questions were newly added before game start. Current build behavior indicates fix is effective: AddQuestion appends IDs and StartGame/CreateRoom fallback to DB question IDs when explicit selection is empty; reproduced scenario now passes end-to-end.
